commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Fairness is knowing that taking what belongs to others isn’t righteous. Covet their good wealth without it, and the coveting ruins your family and at once brings you many faults. It is called good wealth because by nature it makes a family grow and does much good.
